text: $ETH is nudging up 1.002% against $BTC, so it's gaining a bit of ground in BTC terms. Meanwhile $BTC posted a 1.634% rise over the last 24 hours. The 20-coin basket of top-traded alts moved even faster, up about 3.469%, leaving $BTC lagging behind the broader alt pack. In short, $ETH is tightening the spread with $BTC, but the whole alt crowd is outpacing Bitcoin's gain. Nothing wild, just a modest shuffle across the board.
